drafted_from: workflow:find-and-test-the-short-video-formats-that-sell-your-app's row in tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json (its input schema, steps and submit shapes)
start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:find-and-test-the-short-video-formats-that-sell-your-app for my bake-planning app for bakery owners on TikTok, competitors BakePlan and TrayTally, with public video addresses."
no_lists_because: Its output is scripts, a test plan and a log the person starts empty in their own analytics, not rows of a list.
instructions: 1. Write the app in one sentence, its best feature, the category in your words, up to five competitors and the platform you post on.
2. Say "Run workflow:find-and-test-the-short-video-formats-that-sell-your-app" with those values; add library own-tools when you have no DarkUGC account connected.

3. The AI works scope, map-niche, read-videos, score-formats, write-scripts, creators, approve, test-plan and weekly-rerun: it maps what won in 30 and 90 days, reads the 8 best videos, scores formats, writes up to 9 scripts with the app on screen by second 3 and plans a 2-week test.
4. Approve each script exactly as written; nothing is posted by the AI. Film and post on your chosen dates.
5. After the measuring window, drop every format under the stop bar of 5 downloads per 1,000 views and keep the rest; rerun each Monday.

worked_examples.ask: Find the short-video formats for my app.
